impacts.description: Structuring impact on higher education institutions and other entities beyond academia by widely spreading excellence and setting standards for high-quality researcher education and training across the European Research Area (ERA) and worldwide.
Increasing the quality of researchers' training and supervision offered, and strengthening research capacity (e.g. ability to attract funding) of participating organisations.
Improving human resources practices and procedures and providing fairer and more attractive working conditions for researchers, including through career guidance and development.

Contributing to excellent research and boosting jobs, growth and investment by equipping researchers with new knowledge and skills (including transferable skills) and international and inter-sectoral exposure, to fill the top positions of tomorrow.
Building new and sustainable international and inter-sectoral partnerships and networks and better transfer of knowledge between sectors and disciplines, enhancing global reputation and visibility.

The project must set out the magnitude and importance of its contribution to the expected scientific, economic/technological, and societal impacts, beyond the immediate scope and duration of the fellowship, with credible quantified estimates where possible and meaningful.
